about_the_game:
This downloadable content allows you to play the game flying Ka-50 Hokum helicopter. You can select it in most of the single player campaign missions, instant actions, test flights, editor missions or multiplayer.

The Ka-50 ("Hokum") is a single-seat Russian attack helicopter with the distinctive coaxial rotor system. It was designed in the 1980s and adopted for service in the Russian army in 1995.

Supported weapon configurations

Inner hard points
  • S-8 Rockets (B8V20)
  • GSH23L
  • S-13 Rockets (BV13)
  • FAB-250 Bomb
  • S-24 Rockets
  • R-60 (AA-8 Aphid)
Outer hard points
  • S-8 Rockets (B8V20)
  • GSH23L
  • S-13 Rockets (B13)
  • FAB-250 Bomb
  • S-24 Rocket
  • R-60 (AA-8 Aphid)
  • 9K121 Vikhr (AT-16 Scallion) 10 missiles in total
  • 9K38 Igla 8 missiles in total

Supported campaign missions

  • Target artillery
  • Supply convoy
  • Capturing city
  • Attack airbase
  • Lurking in the trees
  • Night silent attack
  • Tanker attack
  • Submarine in trouble
